items.text:
**CASTING / MODELS WANTED FOR ASMR YOUTUBE CONTENT**

I’m looking for **actors, extras and models of all genders** for a variety of professionally filmed ASMR videos for YouTube.

Content will include:
• Head and face massage
• Hair stroking / brushing and soft-touch ASMR
• Relaxation treatments
• Haircuts / transformations and full hot-towel shaves for men

**All treatments are completely free.**

I’m posting here as I’m ideally looking for people who are **comfortable on camera, patient during filming and able to maintain a relaxed/natural expression** while being filmed.

As much of the content is shot close-up, I’m also looking for people who are **photogenic, well-presented and have a natural on-camera presence**. You don’t need to be a professional model.

For haircut transformations, I’m particularly interested in men who are open to a noticeable change of style and a good hairline.

If interested, please **DM me with a couple of recent photos and which type of video you’d be interested in. **

**Location is off mount pleasant and will be shooting on mondays probably.**

Szukasz czegoś więcej niż zwykły warsztat aktorski? 🎭

Odważ się i dołącz do trzeciej edycji Tajemnic - między 9 a 15 listopada! Kameralna grupa, ucieleśnienie słowa, obecność na scenie, śpiew, ruch, oddech, joga i inspirujące miejsce. Po dwóch pierwszych spotkaniach wiedzieliśmy, że musimy robić to dalej! ✨

🎩 Krzysztof Jasiński — założyciel i od 60 lat dyrektor Teatru STU — zaprasza Cię do swojego świata. Tu doświadczenie teatru wychodzi poza warsztat i technikę, i wchodzi w coś głębszego: zrozumienie, połączenie i czucie.

🔮 Sześć dni w kameralnym gronie - będziemy odkrywać, czym naprawdę jest aktorstwo — nie tylko jako rzemiosło, ale jako droga do poznania siebie, przez ciało, emocje i słowo.

🎭 Poprowadzą Cię:
✨ Krzysztof Jasiński — legenda polskiej sceny, twórca Teatru STU
✨ Beata Rybotycka — wokalistka i aktorka STU, dawniej Piwnica pod Baranami
✨ Grzegorz Suski — aktor, reżyser i pedagog
✨ Jagoda Jędrzejowska — instruktorka jogi i masażystka

Nie musisz być zawodowym aktorem/aktorką. To miejsce dla każdego, kto chce pracować na najwyższym poziomie niezależnie od doświadczenia i poznać świat teatru od środka.

📅 9-15 listopada 2026, Studio Grom, Mazury
🎟️ Ceny early-bird tylko do 28 sierpnia!
Liczba miejsc mocno ograniczona.

👉 Zostaw kontakt — napiszemy do Ciebie z pełnymi szczegółami i ankietą zgłoszeniową.

Warsztat dla osób pełnoletnich.

Zaczynamy produkcję nowego sezonu **Trudnych Spaw** w Polot Media co oznacza, że szukamy nowych aktorów! Proszę o uważne przeczytanie charakterystyki i wieku postaci - zgłoszenia kompletnie niezgodne z rolą nie będą rozpatrywane.

Zgłoszenia dla osób z ***WROCŁAWIA***:

**Paweł Łowiński (wiek kandydata od 16 do 18 lat) – syn Marka**

Wygląd: Powyżej 175 cm.

9 scen, od 3 do 5.09.2026

** **

**Wacław Kardowski (wiek kandydata od 37-42 lat) – były mąż głównej bohaterki**

Wygląd: Przystojny i powyżej 180 cm.

Szczegóły: Rozwiódł się z główną bohaterką  z własnej inicjatywy — ma już nową rodzinę.

items.text:
**Casting do rolek dla marki jedzenia błyskawicznego!**

**Poszukujemy 4 głównych bohaterów – 2 dziewczyn i 2 chłopaków.**

Szukamy osób w estetyce współczesnego Gen Z – **naturalnych, autentycznych, charyzmatycznych i swobodnych przed kamerą**. 

Mile widziany vibe twórców TikToka/Instagrama, social media native i naturalna chemia w grupie.

**DZIEWCZYNA 1**
* wiek ekranowy: **18–24 lata**
* mile widziane charakterystyczne fryzury, np. wolf cut, shaggy cut
* piercing, tatuaże i kolorowe włosy są ok

**DZIEWCZYNA 2**
* wiek ekranowy: **20–26 lat**
* vibe: **kreatywna dusza / imprezowiczka**
* mile widziane rude, jasne blond lub kreatywnie koloryzowane włosy
* piercing, tatuaże i indywidualny styl są ok

**CHŁOPAK 1**
* wiek ekranowy: **18–24 lata**
* mile widziane curly/wavy hair
* piercing, tatuaże i indywidualny styl są ok

**CHŁOPAK 2**
* wiek ekranowy: **20–27 lat**
* mile widziany wąs lub zarost
* preferowane dłuższe fryzury z charakterem, np. mullet

**Wymagamy:**
* **zadbanych dłoni**
* **umiejętność jedzenia pałeczkami**

**Dzień nagrań:** 08.09.2026, Warszawa

**Prawa:** 3 miesiące aktywnej promocji + archiwizacja w internecie

**Media:** digital + social media

**Stawka:** 1700 zł netto 

**Etapy castingu:**
1. Zgłoszenie
2. Wybór osób do kolejnego etapu
3. Self-tape na podstawie briefu – szczegóły zostaną przesłane wybranym osobom

Zgłoszenia ze zdjęciem, doświadczeniem i danymi kontaktowymi proszę przesyłać na adres email: **casting.scprojects@gmail.com**

**Zgłoszenia przyjmujemy do piątku 28.08.2026, do godz. 12:00.**

Odezwiemy się do wybranych osób.

🎬 NOWY SEZON SERIALU „GLINIARZE” — NOWI MUNDUROWI! 👮‍♂️
Do nowego sezonu serialu kryminalnego „Gliniarze” poszukuję mężczyzn w wieku 25–45 lat do stałej współpracy na planie jako Mundurowi.

📅 Współpraca odbywa się mniej więcej co 2–3 tygodnie.

🎥 Poszukuję osób zarówno do statystowania, jak i do epizodów — w przypadku epizodów konieczna jest wizytówka aktorska.

Mile widziani panowie w miarę dobrze zbudowani oraz z doświadczeniem na planie filmowym.

📩 Zgłoszenia: natalia@outsetfilms.pl

W tytule maila: „Nowi mundurowi”

W zgłoszeniu proszę podać:

• imię i nazwisko

• wiek

• wzrost

• numer telefonu

• aktualne zdjęcie twarzy

• aktualne zdjęcie sylwetki

• wizytówkę — jeśli zgłaszacie się również do epizodów jako Mundurowy

⚠️ Ważne: grając Mundurowego, nie można w tym samym czasie grać innych epizodów w serialu „Gliniarze”.

Marc Graue is a veteran Hollywood voice actor, professional voice over coach, and voice over demo producer with more than 45 years of experience in the voice over industry. Through Marc Graue Voice Over Studios, he has worked with professional actors, celebrities, newcomers, casting professionals, and major entertainment companies in commercial, animation, video game, character, narration, and other areas of professional voice over.

**Learn more about voice over coaching, professional voice over demos, audition training, animation voice acting, and video game voice over at Marc-Graue.com.**

 

Discover **Marc Graue’s Hollywood Voice Over Blog**, packed with professional **voice over tips, voice acting advice, audition techniques, voice over coaching, demo production strategies, animation voice acting, video game voice over, character voices, commercial voice over**, and real-world Hollywood insight from Marc Graue’s 45+ years in the industry. Learn how to improve your auditions, develop memorable characters, create a professional voice over demo, attract agents and casting directors, and build a successful voice acting career.

Hallo zusammen 😊
ich bin auf der Suche nach einer Möglichkeit, als Kleindarsteller oder Komparse bei verschiedenen Film- und Fernsehproduktionen mitzuwirken. Besonders interessieren mich Serien und Produktionen wie zum Beispiel „Hubert ohne Staller, aber auch andere ähnliche Formate.....

Wisst ihr vielleicht, wie man am besten an solche Rollen kommt? Muss man sich dafür bei einer Casting- oder Komparsenagentur bewerben oder gibt es andere Möglichkeiten, sich direkt bei Produktionsfirmen vorzustellen?

Ich würde mich sehr über eure Erfahrungen, Tipps oder Empfehlungen freuen. Jede einzelne Antwort hilft mir weiter. 🙏

Vielen lieben Dank schon einmal! 😊

👉**NOUVELLES DATES - EIFELTOD**👈** **

Bonjour à toutes et tous,

Nous sommes à la recherche de nouveaux figurants pour le tournage de la série belgo-allemande ***EIFELTOD*** !
En 2 x 90 min, nous serons plongés dans deux enquêtes criminelles révélant progressivement des tragédies familiales.

N'hésitez pas à repostuler si vous n'avez pas encore eu de réponse !

**NOUVELLE DATES à AYWAILLE (à proximité de Liège)**
**07H00-18H00**
**65 € par jour**
un ou deux jours par personne en fonction des profils :

 **HOMMES et FEMMES entre 15 et 80 ans**
pour jouer des clients, des serveurs et des membres du personnel d'un hôtel

**MARDI 29 SEPTEMBRE**
**MERCREDI 30 SEPTEMBRE**
**JEUDI 1er OCTOBRE**
_______

** HOMMES et FEMMES entre 15 et 19 ans** + quelques personnes dès 30 ans
pour jouer des étudiants dans une école, des parents et des profs

**VENDREDI 2 OCTOBRE**
**SAMEDI 3 OCTOBRE**

Si vous êtes disponibles et intéressés, ne tardez pas à nous envoyer un mail à l'adresse **blanche.castpro@gmail.com avec l'objet "EIFELTOD", vos DISPONIBILITÉS du 29/09 au 01/10**.
Merci de préciser si vous avez de l'EXPÉRIENCE en tant que SERVEURS.

Si nous n'avons jamais travaillé ensemble, merci d'envoyer également : NOM, PRÉNOM, DATE DE NAISSANCE, NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE, VILLE DE RÉSIDENCE et 2-3 PHOTOS.

Un grand merci d'avance et au plaisir de vous accueillir sur ce projet !

items.text: I'm a first time director/filmmaker in northeast DC. I have been asking fellow directors this 1 question and every time I ask it, it's always crickets or the stupid obvious ineffective method of tubi. Maybe you guys can help. My question is, as an indie filmmaker how do you generate profit from your movies? I know the obvious answers like putting it in dsps but that's not the answer. I know people aren't generating significant revenue from an indie film that nobody knows about in an oversaturated platform. Can some people be honest and tell me how I can generate money from my movies please

topComments.text: Spend a lot of time online using that type of marketing and then also blip Billboards work really well because you can do those from anywhere in the United States and they're all over the United States I've generated a lot of Revenue from advertising my movies on a billboard and it's electronic so you just create or you can even have them create the artwork and then it's just a small amount to pay to have it put up. Again there's social media which is a great way to do it and you can also make posters and find places in town to hang those up and just put that your movie is available at inserts website or streaming Channel. Stay away from film festivals because those don't make you money those cost you money. And there's no guarantee that you're going to get into them. And get your friends and family to tell other people about it. Create a mailing list where you can use a setup like MailChimp to send out mass emails to people and let them know where to find it if you have new streaming channels that it goes up on you can send out that email as well. Go into film groups that aren't filmmakers but film Watchers and post links in there as well. It's a lot of f****** work but you know what it pays off in the end you can't just throw it out there and expect people to watch it you have to do the work and spend the time to get it out there. Hope that helps.
Marketing!! How will people know that you have a film.

🎬 HAS YOUR CHILD GOT IT?
It's a question I've heard hundreds of times from parents.
“Matt… do you think they could actually be an actor?”
And there's a problem.
I can't answer that by looking at a photograph.
You probably can't answer it from watching them perform around the house.
And sometimes even THEY don't know yet.
You have to give them the opportunity to find out.
Because acting potential comes in all sorts of packages.
🎭 The child who LOVES performing.
🎥 The one obsessed with films and television.
😂 The entertainer who has the whole family laughing.
🧠 The incredibly imaginative one.
👀 The quiet observer who notices EVERYTHING.
Sometimes the child you least expect comes alive when a camera is switched on.

# Currently Casting Quidditch Performers for Warner Bros. Studio Tour

I’m currently casting for an exciting and brand new role of **Quidditch Performer **for Warner Bros. Studio Tour London, the Making of Harry Potter ⚡️

This exciting role offers the opportunity to bring the Quidditch uniforms worn throughout the Harry Potter films to life - engaging with visitors, posing for photos, and creating magical experiences that visitors never forget.

We are seeking experienced and charismatic performers with strong acting, animation and improvisational ability, who are keen to engage with the world of Harry Potter and with to up to 7,000 visitors per day.

**Note**, no stunt experience is required.

Good availability throughout the run (beginning mid-Jan and ending mid-April) is required due to the nature of the role, the training commitments involved, and the fixed duration of the contract. All rehearsals and training must be attended by all successful candidates.

**Role Requirements**
⚡️ To portray our characters, actors must convincingly portray a playing age of 13-18 years old
⚡️ All performers must be comfortable styling their hair and/or makeup independently, with the guidance of Show Experience Management according to the requirements of the character they are portraying
⚡️ Character presentation standards for this role include being clean-shaven for all shifts. We welcome applications from candidates for whom this may not be possible; please raise this at application stage so we can discuss available options
⚡️ Any tattoos must not be visible
⚡️ Hair must be of natural tone or willing to be dyed to a natural shade once the run begins
⚡️ Comfortable being photographed and videoed by and with visitors
⚡️ Comfortable working in crowded and fast paced environments, working under show lighting, special effects and loud noises
⚡️ Comfortable handling props with a variety of shapes and weights
⚡️ Able to contribute positively and enjoy working effectively as part of a large and varied team
⚡️ Demonstrable ability to learn new skills and adapt to new situations within a visitor focused environment
⚡️ Eagerness to exceed expectations and go the extra mile at every opportunity

**All applicants must be available for the following dates:**

12th – 14th October – Auditions
15th – 16th October – Recall Auditions
3rd Nov – 9th Dec – Costume Fittings (1 hour slot on a weekday)
7th -8th January - Training
11th – 22nd January – Rehearsals
23rd January – 19th April – Run begins (we are seeking performers with 3-5 days availability including weekends and bank holidays)

If you are interested, please click the link here to see the job advert and apply: [https://flextalent.wbd.com/job/performer-quidditch-player-in-watford-england-7231753](https://flextalent.wbd.com/job/performer-quidditch-player-in-watford-england-7231753)

Georgie Glover
Show Experience Manager
Warner Bros. Studio Tour London

CASTING CALL - SHORT FILM
NORTH YORKSHIRE

Faith and Stone is a haunting, reimagining of the myth of Orpheus and Eurydice. Set between the ancient world and the claustrophobic, twisted darkness of the underworld of Hades, the film transforms the familiar myth into an intimate story about grief, faith and the unbearable certainty of loss.

After descending into the Underworld to reclaim his dead lover, Orpheus is granted one chance to bring her home - but only if he can resist the uncertainty that she is following him.

Casting Call:

ORPHEUS - Male | Mid 20s - 30s (Lead)

* York / North Yorkshire based

* Confident working in dark, enclosed environments and in the outdoors. This is incredibly important due to the set locations of the shoot.

Orpheus is emotionally driven but not overly theatrical. He begins the film with determination and hope, but as his journey progresses we see his confidence slowly give way to fear, exhaustion and desperation. 

EURYDICE - Female | Mid 20s - 30s (Supporting)

* York / North Yorkshire Based 

* Physical Theatre / Performance & Dance experience not required but appreciated. 

Eurydice is a quiet but emotionally significant role. Much of the character’s impact comes through physical performance, expression and subtle change in behaviour, rather than dialogue. 

Shoot dates to be decided | Filming mid to late September - early October. (Weekend shoot dates). 2-3 day shoot. 

Unpaid. Food, drink and refreshments provided. Travel and accommodation if needed also provided. 

If interested please send:

* Name

* Age 

* Location

* Acting experience 

* Headshot

* Showreel / Previous work (if available).

edwardthompsonfilm@gmail.com

**CASTING CALL Unpaid Student Short Film**

Genre: Sci Fi / Psychological Horror

Logline: NEUROCORP invites you to join the NEUROCORP Lottery, where one winner will have their brain scanned and uploaded into the NEUROCORP database!

CORVIK: A scientist leading NEUROCORP to push the boundaries of mapping Neurons into a machine, effectively being able to copy and paste human consciousness. They do not care about the subject, only about the work being done. Yet they understand the subject isn’t property, a copy of their consciousness is. Corvik is personable, down right charismatic when talking to people, but when talking to a copy of that person's consciousness they are the polar opposite, and looks at that same person as property.

**ANYBODY IS FREE TO CAST. I DO NOT HAVE A DEMOGRAPHIC IN MIND FOR CORVIK ONLY SOMEONE WHO CAN CONVINCE ME THEY ARE CORVIK. **

Shoot will take approximately 2 days, aiming for 1st week of **September! **Shooting will take place in the **Thornton** and** Boulder area. **

This is an 8 page script. If I had to estimate I would say it would take at **most** 4 hours per day (there may be another day for re shoots). We are shooting inside all day and are not rushed by daylight. If you have any questions feel free to email me.

I am **NEVER** on facebook **EMAIL ME** if you're interested!

**EMAIL ME AT:** Cportales60@gmail.com

Casting a cyberpunk student film, "ELEVEN"

When green, healthy trees are a luxury hoarded by the ultra-rich, a thief and an android stand at odds on where these million-dollar seeds ought to go.

Shooting will occur in three weeks on the 11th, 12th, and 13th of September at Lowry Studios in Aurora.

Roles needed:

ENPLANTER (female 20-30)

Born with a silver spoon in her mouth. She raises and sells plants like million-dollar racehorses. Entitlement and corporate-speak are the primary emotional elements.

ROBOT78J (male 20-30)

A humanoid robot designed for companionship, cleaning, and admin support. Cold and soft-spoken.

BOBBY (male 30+)

A career criminal, uncomfortable when a plan has too many holes.

Here is the link to audition sign up: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1NeDp1hfcjSjmXssvkOys5-b2ejBYNCRjIHOw71O-Vm93aw/viewform?usp=header

sharedPost.text:
🎥 In diesem Reel kündigt Silvia Eitler das nächste KBF, mit Mag. Günther Wildner von der Literaturagentur an. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 174. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 01.09.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Vortrag: Die Rolle der Literaturagentur in der Buchbranche 
🎙️ Mag. Günther Wildner (Literaturagentur Wildner) 
🎤 Moderation: Silvia Eitler 

Wie funktionieren Künstler*innen-Aufbau und Manuskriptvermittlung im aktuellen Literaturbetrieb? Was sollen oder dürfen Autor*innen schreiben? Welche Anforderungen stellen Verlage und weitere Player in der Buchbranche an die Verfasser*innen? 

Günther Wildner berichtet aus seiner Praxis als Literaturagent, PR-Arbeiter für Bücher und Lesungsbooker und gibt Einblicke in die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Autor*innen, Agenturen und Verlagen. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die mehr darüber erfahren möchten, wie der Literaturbetrieb funktioniert, welche Rolle Literaturagenturen dabei spielen und wie Manuskripte ihren Weg zu Verlagen und Leser*innen finden. 

© Dan D. Joseph

items.text:
Looking for representation for my son. He is 8 and we are located in Portland, Oregon. Loves the outdoors, golf, tennis swimming and is super outgoing. He's the type of kid everyone knows because of his positive personality and his sense of humor. 

We are looking for an agent. 

Advice please ❤️

topComments.text:
Well 
Don’t pay upfront agency fees or photographers that charge more than a few hundred dollars for headshots - start with your own iPhone - 
Make sure that you understand as a parent that a flexible schedule is most important 
Research people and companies before signing and also if anyone wants exclusive make sure to ask how many kids his age and look they represent 

It is likely that your child will need classes, but don’t fall over the old barn/Casablancas. Those classes are designed to make you feel good not necessarily to procure work because they’ll just tell you how great they’re doing and not be realistic and tell them that he might not be doing as good as he could you gotta get honest feedback not people just trying to get information and money from you 
Make sure you read all the contracts carefully. Make sure that you have follow up emails templates and again do your research.

# **Currently Casting for Quidditch Performers at Warner Bros Studio Tour London**

I’m currently casting for an exciting and brand new role of **Quidditch Performer** for Warner Bros. Studio Tour London, the Making of Harry Potter ⚡️

This exciting role offers the opportunity to bring the Quidditch uniforms worn throughout the Harry Potter films to life - engaging with visitors, posing for photos, and creating magical experiences that visitors never forget.

We are seeking experienced and charismatic performers with strong acting, animation and improvisational ability, who are keen to engage with the world of Harry Potter and with to up to 7,000 visitors per day.

**Note**, no stunt experience is required.

Good availability throughout the run (beginning mid-Jan and ending mid-April) is required due to the nature of the role, the training commitments involved, and the fixed duration of the contract. All rehearsals and training must be attended by all successful candidates.

**Role Requirements**
⚡️ To portray our characters, actors must convincingly portray a playing age of 13-18 years old
⚡️ All performers must be comfortable styling their hair and/or makeup independently, with the guidance of Show Experience Management according to the requirements of the character they are portraying
⚡️ Character presentation standards for this role include being clean-shaven for all shifts. We welcome applications from candidates for whom this may not be possible; please raise this at application stage so we can discuss available options
⚡️ Any tattoos must not be visible
⚡️ Hair must be of natural tone or willing to be dyed to a natural shade once the run begins
⚡️ Comfortable being photographed and videoed by and with visitors
⚡️ Comfortable working in crowded and fast paced environments, working under show lighting, special effects and loud noises
⚡️ Comfortable handling props with a variety of shapes and weights
⚡️ Able to contribute positively and enjoy working effectively as part of a large and varied team
⚡️ Demonstrable ability to learn new skills and adapt to new situations within a visitor focused environment
⚡️ Eagerness to exceed expectations and go the extra mile at every opportunity

**All applicants must be available for the following dates:**
12th – 14th October – Auditions
15th – 16th October – Recall Auditions
3rd Nov – 9th Dec – Costume Fittings (1 hour slot on a weekday)
7th -8th January - Training
11th – 22nd January – Rehearsals
23rd January – 19th April – Run begins (we are seeking performers with 3-5 days availability including weekends and bank holidays)

If you are interested, please click the link here to see the job advert and apply: [https://flextalent.wbd.com/job/performer-quidditch-player-in-watford-england-7231753](https://flextalent.wbd.com/job/performer-quidditch-player-in-watford-england-7231753)

Georgie Glover
Show Experience Manager
Warner Bros. Studio Tour London

items.text:
Witam!

Do udziału w kampanii społecznej na temat szkodliwości spożywania alkoholu w ciąży poszukujemy:
1. GŁÓWNEJ BOHATERKI - kobiety w wieku 25–30 lat, dla której język polski jest językiem ojczystym
2. PARTNERA - mężczyzny w wieku 28–35 lat, dla którego język polski jest językiem ojczystym
3. CIOCI - kobiety w wieku 45–50 lat, dla której język polski jest językiem ojczystym
4. WUJKA - mężczyzny w wieku 50–55 lat, dla którego język polski jest językiem ojczystym
5. STATYSTÓW - dwóch osób, płeć dowolna

Szczegóły projektu:
1. Lokalizacja: prywatny dom pod Warszawą, około 25 km od Mokotowa
2. Dzień zdjęciowy: 2 września, jeden dzień na planie
3. Pola eksploatacji: internet, media społecznościowe oraz prezentacje podczas konferencji. 
4. Dialogi: krótkie kwestie – około 3–4 zdań, być może tylko jedno zdanie
5. Zapewniamy wynagrodzenie za udział w kampanii.

Zgłoszenia (wizytówkę, nagranie itp.) prosimy przesyłać mailowo na adres: sync@mi82.eu

**W tytule wiadomości prosimy zaznaczyć, na którą rolę Państwo aplikują.**

Dziękuję bardzo i pozdrawiam.

items.text:
Looking for recent experiences with Lavonne’s The Agency in LA/Burbank. Has anyone’s child been represented by them recently? Did your child get auditions/bookings, and how was your overall experience? Would you recommend them? Looking for honest firsthand experiences—positive or negative.

Thank you. Has anyone here actually had their child represented by Lavonne’s in the last 1–2 years? I’d especially love to hear firsthand experiences about submissions/auditions and communication.

topComments.text:
I wouldn’t call them a scam. I would just say they are not well respected and ethical. 
They sign anyone and everyone, try and poach kids, charge them for photos, sell workshops etc. 

They are licensed, bonded, on the casting platforms and do book kids occasionally. But they are kinda bottom of the barrel and don’t operate ethically. 
 
I would pass and look for someone a lot more reputable.

scam. stay away. her only goal is to try to poach kids from other agencies, and she does it unabashedly. we never see her agency name at any professional sign ins. i don't know what happens with online submissions, but every agent in town has had lavonne try to poach kids, so everyone knows her and there is zero respect. i don't know if she tries to do anything else on the sketch side (like charging fees), but frankly, i wouldn't have even opened the email, much less considered the option. #straightintothetrash

Must have a valid passport.

Parents and guardians please apply asap to: streetcasting@kharmelcochrane.co.uk with the subject "Skater Teen".

Please include full name, age, location, selfie & a short intro detailing your skateboarding experience.

Open Casting Call!

**CU Denver senior thesis film**

**Title:***** ****NO SAINTS*

**Genre: **Supernatural / Drama

**Logline: **An angel confronts a murderer.

**Characters:**

Lucy: 25-40 F

Civil war has come upon America again, and Lucy’s brother is drafted, leaving her to care for his two children. She’s educated and capable, and was meant for something more than this– but what other option is there?

A month ago, she discovered an enemy trooper hiding in the barn, and killed him in a panic. She pushes this secret deep down, but the guilt is eating her alive.

Soldier/Angel: 25-40 M

An angel, sent from Heaven to roam the Earth and collect confessions from sinners. He’s cold and calculating, and has no sympathy for the people he visits. What does it matter, as long as the job gets done? 

Monica: 15-18 F

Lucy’s niece, old enough to want to know more about the war and what she can do to help the family, to Lucy’s chagrin. 

Corey: 5-10 M

Lucy’s nephew, observant beyond his years. He doesn’t speak, expressing himself through his drawings instead. 

**Compensation:** Compensation for gas, meals, film credit, film copy

**Audition Information:** 

Please fill out the form below! Callbacks will be held in person, scheduled at a time that works for you. 

[Self-Tape Form](https://forms.gle/DWUHDLsoNA1sJPLw9) 

**Shoot Dates: **The goal is late October-early November, depending on everyone's schedules. 4 days for Lucy and the Soldier, likely only 2 days for the kids.

**Shooting Locations: **A cabin in Idaho Springs, and one other location TBD

If you have any questions whatsoever, please email [eloradodrill@gmail.com](mailto:eloradodrill@gmail.com). We’d love to work with you!

**CASTING CALL**

**Title: **Take Me to Ithaca

**Genre: **Comedy, Action, Road-trip

**Log line:**

A darkly funny road-trip crime story about a hitman who wants out—and the unlikely friendship that gets in his way.

**Contact Info**: [Sawyer.macres@gmail.com](mailto:Sawyer.macres@gmail.com)

**Production Type: **Indie

**Run Time: **Feature Film

**Compensation: **Paid (Day Players) / Stipend (Extras) Copy, Credit

**Dates: October / November (Weekends)**

**Location: Denver / Loveland, CO**

**Union Status: **non-union

*****Most roles have been filled for this project, but still casting for the following:**

**Crystal (Female) (20-30s)  (Day Player): **

A prostitute drifting through the world.

**Anna (Female) (10-14) (Day Player):**

The cello-playing niece of Charlie, a mobster who runs an underground crime syndicate. Anna’s goal is to play a perfect recital for her uncle + family but caves under the pressure and ends up botching the solo. Ideally looking for a cello player or someone who could “act” like they do.

**Anna’s Mother ( Female) (40’s) (Extra):**

Part of a mob family.

**Anna’s Father ( Male) (40’s) (Extra)**

Part of the mob family.

**8 - 10 Mobster Bodyguards (Male) (Extras)**

Tough, no-nonsense hitmen and mobsters.

**3 Waitresses (20’s) (Female) (Extras):**

Mexican-American waitresses that work at their dad’s restaurant. Bonus points for the ability to blow a bubble with chewing gum.

**Extras, Misc (Extras):**

We have scenes we’re looking to fill with extras, so if you’re interested in being on a film set, please reach out!

Audition Information: please send headshots, resume and/or reel to the email above.

topComments.text: Just commenting that Sawyer is awesome to work with! 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽￼

items.text:
**CASTING CALL – Child & Adult Models | PAID**

I'm casting children and adults for **Round **Two of a** larger non-speaking product video project** featuring creative building toys. Non-union.

I'm currently building out my talent roster for this next phase, with filming expected to take place mid-to-late September in the Lower Mainland, BC.

**CURRENTLY CASTING**

**Group 5**
* Age 5–7, Female, Asian
* Age 8–11, Male, Asian

**Group 6**
* Age 6–8, Male, Hispanic
* Age 6–8, Female, Hispanic
* Mixed ethnicity / mid-skinned children may also be considered

**Group 7**
* Age 6–9, Female, Caucasian
* Age 6–9, Male, Black / dark-skinned

**Group 8**
* Age 5–7, Female, Caucasian
* Age 8–11, Female, Asian

**Group 9**
* Age 5–7, Male, Asian
* Age 8–10, Female, Asian

**Group 10**
* Age 5–7, Male, Black 
* Age 8–11, Female, Black
* Mixed ethnicity / dark-skinned children may also be considered

**Group 11**

Children:
* Age 5–7, Female, Caucasian
* Age 8–11, Male, Asian
* Age 8–11, Female, Mixed Ethnicity

Adults:
* Age 36–45, Male, Caucasian
* Age 25–35, Female, Asian
* Age 60+, Female, Mixed Ethnicity

We're looking for talent who are comfortable on camera and able to follow simple direction. For child roles, we're looking for kids who enjoy playing and interacting naturally with toys.

Previous acting or modelling experience is welcome, but **not required**.

**PROJECT DETAILS**
* Non-speaking roles
* Filming: Mid-to-late September
* Location: TBD-Lower Mainland, BC
* Pay: $50 CAD/hour with a 3-hour minimum guarantee ($150 minimum per person)
* Most talent will likely be needed for approximately 1–2 hours
* A parent or guardian must remain on set for all child participants

**IMPORTANT – USAGE & CONFIDENTIALITY**

This project is being produced under a strict client confidentiality clause. Finished videos will be used digitally across the client's Amazon, website, social media, and online advertising.

Finished videos and production materials cannot be provided to talent or used for portfolios, demo reels, social media, or personal use. **Please only apply if you are comfortable with these terms.**

**PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED?**

If you have **already emailed me about your child for phase 1 of this project, you do not need to apply again.** I have your information on file and will be reaching out for this next phase if you or your child may be a fit for one of the roles.

**TO APPLY**

Please email **[runestonepics@gmail.com](mailto:runestonepics@gmail.com)** with:
* Group number(s) you're applying for
* Applicant's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (casual phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability in mid-to-late September
* Previous acting or modelling experience, if applicable

**Subject Line:** Group # – Age – Gender
Example: **Group 5 – Age 6 – Female**

If your child fits more than one group, feel free to include all applicable group numbers.

If you have two children who fit both roles within the same group, please include both children in one email and provide the requested information and photos for each child.

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and required forms.

🎬 CASTING CALL: 2 MALE ROLES WANTED FOR SHORT FILM 🎬

Isaiah Smith Films is casting two male roles for a short film shooting in the Atlanta area.
---

Two men on a porch. One selling the future, one who just lost his job to it. It's only two characters, mostly dialogue, and there's real tension in it. Good scene to have on a reel.
---

DETAILS 📅

Location: Atlanta area, one location
Date: September. Day TBD (once I have everyone's availability)
Length of shoot: 4-5 hours
Non-union
---

THE ROLES 🎭

The salesman-
20s. Sharp, likable, believes what he's selling. He's not a villain.

The other guy-
40s to 50s. Worked hard, did everything right, and just found out that wasn't enough.

Ethnicity open.
---

COMPENSATION: UNPAID 📋

Footage of yourself for your reel
Credit on the finished film
A short that goes online where you can point people to it
---

ABOUT ME 🎥

I'm Isaiah Jeremiah, a filmmaker and editor with post credits on Ryan Murphy's American Horror Stories, Lost in Space, The Old Man, Good Trouble, and several more. I moved to Georgia recently and I'm hoping to find some people out here to shoot with.

This one is unpaid, and I know that's not for everybody. But if what you need right now is time in front of the camera and something finished to show for it, this could be worth your day.

I handle the entire production side. Camera, lenses, lights, the script, licensed music, and I cut it myself. There's no crew to work around and nothing for you to bring but yourself and your lines.

Before the shoot we'll hop on a quick call to go through the script, talk about your read on the character, and answer whatever you want to ask. On the day, the first hour is just us. We go over the script and do a rehearsal/walkthrough. Then we roll, run the scene(s) from a few angles, and you'll have room to try things.
---

HOW TO APPLY 💻

Go to onboard.IsaiahSmithFilms.com

If these roles aren't for you, sign up anyway. More roles are coming, and you'll be on the list.
---

Questions only: IsaiahSmith0007@gmail.com
(all submissions go through the link above)

MÄNNLICHE HAUPTROLLE – MUSICAL (VERGÜTET)
Für die kontinentaleuropäische Erstaufführung des Zwei-Personen-Musicals  “THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK” suchen wir einen männlichen Darsteller/Sänger für eine zentrale Rolle. 

ÜBER DAS STÜCK:

New York 1950. Ein Broadway-Komponist, dessen Name heute vollkommen in Vergessenheit geraten ist. Seine Songs, seine Geschichten und alte Theater-Mythen führen zwei Menschen auf die Suche nach der Wahrheit einer vergessenen Broadway Legende. 

DIE ROLLE:

Die männliche Hauptrolle in “THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK” ist ein charismatischer, humorvoller und aufgeschlossener Schauspieler, der von der mysteriösen Geschichte rund um Wilbur Weissman fasziniert ist. Im Laufe des Stücks schlüpft er in mehrere verschiedene Rollen und verkörpert damit die unterschiedlichen Figuren innerhalb des „Stücks im Stück“. Die Rolle erfordert daher eine hohe schauspielerische Wandlungsfähigkeit, Spielfreude und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Charaktere präzise und glaubwürdig zum Leben zu erwecken. Die Rolle trägt den Namen des Darstellers.

Spielalter: 25 – 40 Jahre

Stimmfach: Bariton/hoher Bariton (g² – f⁴)

Geschlecht: male presenting

Spiel- & Probenort: Wien (Leider kann keine Unterkunft gestellt werden.)

WIR SUCHEN: 

– hervorragender Schauspieler und Sänger

– sehr starke Bühnenpräsenz

– gutes Timing und komödiantisches Gespür

– Tanzkenntnisse erforderlich (Jazz/Musical)

– sehr gutes Englisch (c1 - c2)

– Interesse an Jazz und Musical

Professionelle Ausbildung und/oder einschlägige Bühnenerfahrung ist vorausgesetzt. Erfahrung im Jazz- & Musical Bereich sind stark von Vorteil.

PRODUKTION: 

THE FORGOTTEN SONGBOOK – von Emerson Hurley und Dylan McBurney

Regie: Simon Malleczek

Musikalische Leitung: Emerson Hurley

Premiere: April 2027, Freie Bühne Wien

Produktion: Theater zwischen Welten

Sprache: Dialog in Deutscher- & Songs in Englischer Sprache.

BEWERBUNG: 

Bitte schicke uns: 

– Kurzbiographie

– Künstlerische Vita

– Portraitfoto

– Hörprobe/Video (keine Voraussetzung)

 Bewerbungen bitte mit dem Betreff “Bewerbung TFS – [Dein Name]” an “office@zwischen-welten.theater” bis zum 20.09.26 einreichen. Es werden nur vollständige Bewerbungen berücksichtigt. Im Falle einer Einladung zum Casting schicken wir dir weitere Informationen und Voraussetzungen. 

Bei Fragen: PN

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

**PAID OPPORTUNITY: Guest Improv Teacher**

Lockdown Projections Theatre Company is looking for an experienced improv teacher to lead a playful, accessible session as part of our next Devise & Conquer workshop.

📅 Wednesday 9th September 2026
⏰ 11am–12.30pm (90 minutes)
📍 Bigfringe Studios, Fish Island, Hackney Wick, London
💷 £50 flat fee, equivalent to £33.33 per teaching hour and inclusive of travel/expenses

We’re looking for a session using short-form games and exercises to develop storytelling, spontaneity and narrative-building. It should be suitable for adult beginners and mixed experience levels. It may draw on skills used in long-form improv, but shouldn’t be a dedicated long-form workshop.

Our workshops are open to everyone, although many attendees are low-support-needs neurodivergent adults. Experience creating inclusive sessions and supporting different communication needs is particularly welcomed.

To apply, please email **lockdownprojections@gmail.com** with:
* A short introduction and details of your improv teaching experience
* Confirmation that you’re available on 9 September
* Any experience teaching beginners, mixed-level groups or neurodivergent adults
* Confirmation that you’re available for a short video call before the booking is confirmed
* Any other devising or theatre-making skills you teach

Not available on 9 September? You’re still welcome to get in touch, as we’re building a pool of guest facilitators for future workshops.

items.text:
Am Sonntag den 23.08.2026 zwischen 11:55 und 13:45 Uhr haben wir es wieder getan.
Wir sind eine Kampfsport Schule, die dreckige Spielplätze sauber macht.
Die Idee ist daraus entstanden, als wir 2018 draußen am Güterbahnhof in unserer Heimatstadt, Neuss trainierten.
Der überdachte Platz, an dem viele Kinder spielen und den wir gelegentlich auch als Trainingsfläche nutzten, war voller Glasscherben, Zigarettenstummel Essensverpackungen und weitere Gegenstände, die wir hier nicht näher aufzählen möchten.
Wir hätten unser Training auch irgendwo anders hin verlegen können und uns sagen können: „Ach, was interessiert uns, dass der Platz hier so zugemüllt ist und die Kinder nicht dadrauf spielen können. 
Wir suchen uns einfach einen neuen Platz.“
Haben wir aber nicht gemacht.

Film opowiada historię młodej dziewczyny, Sexy, która wyprowadza się na nawiedzone Rondo, gdzie

woman, Sexy. She moves to a haunted Roundabout where she meets Sabina, ,,friendly” ghost.

WORK FLOW - animation is made with photos, so each actress will be photographed separately

for people from different cities in Poland.

- Must speak well-spoken English

CASTING CALL - A Last Crusade an Independent short Film - NON-UNION

Read through date: Friday, Sept 4th, 2026
Shoot Date: Saturday, Sept 5th, 2026

Location: North Delta, BC

Compensation: $100 flat (7 max hour shoot (hoping for 5 hours) + 1 hour read through)

We are casting an 18+ male with a smaller build. 

Synopsis: One part heart warming family drama and one part existential horror; A Last Crusade follows Bret, as his recently deceased Father reappears to him in a dream with the simple request of binge watching the original Indiana Jones trilogy with him, one final time.

Role Description:

Bret (20s): A meek nerdy young adult who has a strained relationship with his father.

If you are interested, please submit your Headshots, CV, and a reel (if available) to aleksanderoclarino@gmail.com using subject line: A Last Crusade Bret Audition. We will reply with a copy of the script, if we are interested.

We are very excited to see your submissions.

items.text:
"Happy Little Accident" Casting Call for 
Shits n' Giggles short film.
“Happy Little Accident”

What if you could check a person out of a library the same way you check out a book and instead of reading their story, you could borrow their perspective, ask for advice or learn something from them? “Happy Little Accident” is a dark dramedy about addiction and recovery. But at its heart, it asks this question: What if helping someone take their first step forces you to confront your own sobriety?

DIESEL - a large bearded man, biker type, but very well spoken and intelligent, in his late 40's-50’s.

JESSICA - Female,mid 30’s presents all business but tired; professional dreamer, mom, trophy wife with the heart of a CEO, quick witted but a mess inside. 

RECEPTIONIST- Caring librarian type type, 50+

Shoot Date: September 6, 2026 - 8:00am

"The Recovered Arts Collective is producing as part of their Filmmakers Bootcamp. We are strongly supporting the creation of a cast with peoples with lived experience of addiction as this is the underlying theme of both films, but not a requirment. As well, we are seeking submissions from all communities including IBPOC and 2SLGBTQIA+."
Casting Call
1. Carefully read character profiles
2. Submit photo, resume and character(s) you wish to audition for at: https://forms.gle/TrkUhDMHCv4C6LVS8 or email hello@therecoveredartscollective.org
3. You will receive a script portion for self-tape.
4. Make self tape as per industry standards - BUT WOW! US! 
5. Upload self-tape to YouTube or Vimeo and email link to email:hello@therecoveredartscollective.org NO DOWNLOAD LINKS

Volunteer basis, IMDB credit, Video for Reel, Lunch provided.
#soberaf #recovery #recoveryispossible #recoveryjourney #mentalhealth

# 🎬 STATISTER SØGES TIL KORTFILM I AARHUS 🎬

Vi er lige nu i fuld gang med kortfilmen *ELTAL*, en **cassette sci-fi**. Hertil mangler vi nogle statister.

**VI SØGER STATISTER**
* Alder: Fra 18 år og op
* Køn er underordnet

**LIDT OM PROJEKTET**

*ELTAL* foregår i en verden, hvor tid er blevet den nye valuta. Da Erland uretfærdigt bliver fyret fra sit arbejde, står han tilbage med kun få timers strøm, før hans liv er slut. I et desperat forsøg på at overleve må han finde alternative måder at skaffe strøm på.

**DET PRAKTISKE**
* **Optagelser:** Lørdag d. 12. september
* **Lokation:** Aarhus
* Projektet er ulønnet, men vi sørger selvfølgelig for god forplejning på set.

**KONTAKT**

Hvis du har lyst til at være med eller kender nogen, der kunne være et godt match, så send mig en besked og et billede af dig selv her på Facebook eller på mail: [marie.korsgaard.rasmussen@gmail.com](mailto:marie.korsgaard.rasmussen@gmail.com). 🎥

**CASTING CALL**

Title: Romulus 

Genre: Drama

Logline: A volatile, emotionally guarded teenage boy attempting to find his dysfunctional mother on the Fourth of July, after being abandoned with his stern grandmother.

Hello! My name is Rayonna Price and I am producing a University of Colorado Denver Senior Thesis Film. Written and Directed by Saroja Manickam, Romulus is a coming-of-age film that explores the themes of generational trauma and grief.

We are currently casting for ALL ROLES! Lead role and supporting will be COMPENSATED!

**Cody** (13-15, Male, LEADING): An emotionally guarded teenager grieving his mother’s abandonment. *Must be comfortable with profanity and mature themes.*

**Maggie** (20's-30's, Female, Supporting): Cody’s mother, a dysfunctional woman who loves fiercely but without stability. She struggles with her mental health and substance abuse, complicating her ability to parent.

**June** (60's, Female, Supporting): Cody’s grandmother, a blunt, no-nonsense woman guarding her guilt. Her love isn't always tender but it's constant.

**Young Mother** (20's-30's, Female, Extra): A mom Cody mistakens for his own

**Young Cody/Child** (5-10, Male, Extra): A younger Cody and the son of the mother Cody mistakens as Maggie.

To audition both In-Person and through Self-Tape, please scan the QR code or fill out the form linked: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfSbxLLuja8spbcybSSjtnSnSAZlJHrWNCGcq0gwf_fY0g0kg/viewform?usp=header](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfSbxLLuja8spbcybSSjtnSnSAZlJHrWNCGcq0gwf_fY0g0kg/viewform?usp=header)

Here is the link to our Backstage as well: [https://www.backstage.com/casting/romulus-3222070/](https://www.backstage.com/casting/romulus-3222070/)

All In-Person Auditions will take place on September 5th-6th from 11 a.m.-3 p.m. at Denver Public Library: Rodolfo "Corky" Gonzales Branch Library on the second floor conference room. 

If you have any questions, please email me at pricer625@gmail.com

Thank you!

Non-AEA signups are officially open!! NOW CASTING both AEA and non-union talent!!
SG Casting is casting The Lone Tree Arts Center’s production of Amadeus in Lone Tree, Colorado!

Both local and non-local talent are encouraged to submit an audition!

AEA audition sign ups will open on Monday, August 17th.

Non-AEA audition sign ups will open on Wednesday, August 26th.

If you are local, please sign up for an in-person audition if possible.  

If you are not local, please plan to submit a video audition. 

The Lone Tree Arts Center’s Executive Director is Leigh Chandler.

LORT D Contract

Weekly Rate:

$950.00 minimum for Principals and Understudies/Swings

Director: Geoffrey Kent

Executive Director: Leigh Chandler

Casting Director: Sylvia Gregory, CSA

All above creative team members will be present at auditions and viewing audition videos.

In Person Initial Auditions: Monday September 14th and Tuesday September 15th.

In Person Callbacks: Monday October 5th; will add Tuesday October 6th if needed.

Video general auditions are due by Friday September 11th..

Video callbacks are due by Friday, October 2nd.

First Rehearsal - 3/16/27

Tech Starts - 3/31/27

Invited Rehearsals - 4/7/27

Opening - 4/8/27

Closing - 4/18/27

General Audition Requirements:

Please prepare one monologue or two contrasting monologues not to exceed 3 minutes total.

For in-person and video auditions:

In person auditions are by appointment only. Sign up, upload headshots and resumes, and/or submit your videos all at this link: 

https://www.lonetreeartscenter.org/amadeusauditions

Headshot and Resume are REQUIRED to be uploaded into Production Tools.

Do not contact members of the production teams. If you have any questions, contact Saundra Bergman at Saundra.Bergman@cityoflonetree.com.

The Lone Tree Arts Center is committed to diversity and maintains a policy of equal employment opportunity designed to promote a positive model of inclusion. As such, we encourage performers of all ethnicities, gender identities, body types and sizes, and ages, as well as performers with disabilities, to audition for appropriate roles.

The Lone Tree Arts Center creates a safe and equitable workplace through policies defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, the Actors’ Equity Association, and the City of Lone Tree. These policies provide a comprehensive framework for health and safety of all actors, stage managers, creative staff, and designers employed by The Lone Tree Arts Center.

Information and Character Breakdown

CASTING NOTE:

Antonio Salieri and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart will be cast with male-presenting performers. Constanze Weber will be cast with a female-identifying performer, as the character is pregnant at one point in the play. 

All other roles are open to performers of any gender. Performers of all genders and gender expressions are encouraged to audition. 

Character genders, pronouns, relationships, and historical identities will remain as written in the script; performers will not be asked to portray a gender different from their own.

Roles:

ANTONIO SALIERI, male-presenting, 50 to 65

Court Composer to the Emperor. Brilliant, ambitious, and deeply conflicted, he serves as narrator while recounting his lifelong rivalry with Mozart. Exceptional command of language and emotional range required.

WOLFGANG AMADEUS MOZART, male-presenting, 25 to 35

A musical genius with boundless wit, irreverence, and youthful energy. Mercurial, funny, and deeply vulnerable beneath his exuberance.

CONSTANZE WEBER MOZART, female-presenting, 20 to 35 

Mozart’s devoted wife. Intelligent, resilient, and fiercely practical as she struggles to support her husband and family. Role will also include Ensemble work.

EMPEROR JOSEPH II, 35 to 55 

Emperor of Austria. Affable, curious, and genuinely devoted to music, though often unaware of his own limitations. Strong comic instincts. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON VAN SWIETEN, 50 to 70 

Influential patron of the arts. Intellectual, dignified, and quietly authoritative. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT VON STRACK, 35 to 60 

Court official. Polished, ambitious, and committed to preserving decorum and tradition. Role will also include Ensemble work.

COUNT ORSINI-ROSENBERG, 40 to 65 

Imperial Director of Opera. Conservative, politically savvy, and skeptical of artistic risk. Role will also include Ensemble work.

BARON WALSEGG, 40 to 65 

Wealthy aristocrat with a mysterious presence. Reserved and imposing. Role will also include Ensemble work.

Two VENTICELLI, 30 to 50 

The “Little Winds.” Nimble storytellers who provide gossip, exposition, and comic energy. Excellent timing and verbal dexterity required.

KATHERINA CAVALIERI, 20 to 40 

Celebrated soprano and former student of Salieri. Confident, poised, and accustomed to admiration. Classical singing ability welcome but not required. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

TERESA SALIERI, 40 to 60 

Salieri’s wife. Quiet, observant presence. (No dialogue). Role will also include Ensemble work.

ENSEMBLE

18+ To portray courtiers, servants, musicians, clergy, and opera performers. Strong ensemble skills and comfort with multiple roles. Singing and movement abilities a plus.

Hello there, everybody how are you all doing? My name is Sean McLean. I’m an actor a model and a musician.

# **Be Our Mrs Claus at Hertfordshire Zoo!**

Hertfordshire Zoo is looking for jolly, enthusiastic, and festive individuals to bring the magic of Christmas to life this year as Mrs Claus at **Hertfordshire Zoo in Broxbourne, Hertfordshire.**

You’ll be a part of our brand new Christmas event, spreading joy and cheer to families visiting the zoo. 

**What We’re Looking For:**
* A warm, friendly personality with plenty of festive spirit
* Confidence interacting with children and families
* Reliability and professionalism
* Previous performance or grotto experience (preferred but not essential)

**When You’ll Work:**
* 4th November
* 21st & 22nd November
* 28th & 29th November
* 5th & 6th December
* 12th & 13th December
* 19th, 20th, 21st, 22nd, 23rd & 24th December

**PLEASE NOTE** - You are not required to be available to work on all of these dates. Any availability is accepted.

The experience runs throughout the day and evening, so shift times will be within those times.

**What We Offer:**
* A fun and rewarding role in a magical setting
* £20.00 per hour (plus 12.07% holiday pay)
* Full costume and training provided
* The chance to work at one of Hertfordshire's most loved attractions

If you would love to make Christmas unforgettable for our visitors, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now by emailing **[entertainment@hertfordshirezoo.com](mailto:entertainment@hertfordshirezoo.com)**

I'm a casting researcher from Manchester & I’m working with Stark Casting- looking for diverse UK based women aged 25-35 for a bodywash campaign for a well known beauty brand 🕊️

Must NOT be a model/ actor / influencer as it’s part of the brands ethos that they only use NON PROFESSIONALS in all their advertising 🩶

This is a very well paid opportunity! I can send more info & the brand etc via DM <33
Dates needed are between beginning- mid Oct 2026 in LONDON.

Give me a message here or on Instagram @romeycasting if you or someone you know fit the brief! If for some reason you can’t reach me- you can always email me too at romeycasting@gmail.com 
Feel free to share 🫶🏼

Hello tout le monde,

Mannequin et comédien représenté en agence, je suis actuellement à la recherche de nouvelles opportunités artistiques :

Shootings, mode, publicité, cinéma, télévision, théâtre, clips, projets éditoriaux, collaborations créatives, …

Mon univers ne s'arrête pas à l'image :

Je travaille également autour de la mise en scène, l'écriture, la composition et la musique.

J'aime particulièrement les projets avec une vraie identité et les rencontres entre différents univers artistiques.

Book Actor / Model : https://fredericmirza.book.fr/

Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/je_suis_66/

YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/@66Gramofficiel

Si tu es photographe, réalisateur·rice, directeur·rice de casting, styliste, créateur·rice, metteur·se en scène, artiste ou que tu recherches simplement un profil pour un projet, n'hésite pas à me contacter en MP.

Un partage ou une identification est toujours le bienvenu.

Au plaisir de découvrir vos projets et, peut-être, de créer quelque chose ensemble!

Fred

CASTING COMEDIENNES - MINI SERIE POLITIQUE WEB 

Pour un tournage de pilote (2min), à Paris, prévu cet automne en vue des élections présidentielles et réalisé par Galaad HEMSI, nous recherchons deux comédiennes

- Actrice Noire entre 30 et 40 ans

- Actrice Méditerranéenne entre 30 et 40 ans

 

S'agissant d'un pilote en autoproduction, aucune rémunération n'est prévu pour ce tournage de 2 jours.

Merci d'envoyer votre candidature 2 photos + CV + Bande Démo + **présentation de max 2 min où vous parlez ce que représente pour vous l'engagement en politique** à [talents@desert-prod.com](mailto:hello@desert-prod.com)

Seules les candidatures correspondantes seront étudiées. 

Merci et belle journée !

Chcesz zacząć przygodę z modelingiem, ale nie wiesz, od czego zacząć i czego właściwie powinnaś się nauczyć?

A może już chodzisz na castingi, bierzesz udział w sesjach, próbujesz swoich sił, ale masz poczucie, że wciąż stoisz w miejscu?

Patrzysz, jak inne dziewczyny dostają kolejne zlecenia i współprace, a Ty po raz kolejny słyszysz „odezwiemy się”?
Na wybiegu brakuje Ci pewności i techniki?
A przed aparatem wracasz ciągle do tych samych póz i min?

To nie musi oznaczać, że brakuje Ci urody, figury czy odpowiednich warunków, bo dziś modeling szuka różnorodności i osobowości. Wiele elementów pracy modelki można po prostu wypracować - poprzez wiedzę, technikę i praktykę.

Dlatego stworzyliśmy warsztaty skoncentrowane na dwóch umiejętnościach, które mają kluczowe  znaczenie w pracy modelki:

✦ WALK z Piotrem Koprowskim, półfinalistą TOP MODEL 13
Nie tylko nauczysz się chodzić po wybiegu. Popracujesz nad postawą, sylwetką, rytmem, krokiem, pracą ciała i sposobem prezentacji, aby poruszać się pewniej i bardziej świadomie - także podczas castingów.

✦ POZOWANIE DO ZDJĘĆ PORTRETOWYCH
Nauczysz się świadomie pracować spojrzeniem, mimiką, ustawieniem twarzy i górnej części ciała, żeby nie być modelką jednej miny i pokazać przed obiektywem większy zakres swojej ekspresji.

✦ PROFESJONALNE PORTRETY DO PORTFOLIO
Na koniec otrzymasz dwa profesjonalne zdjęcia wykonane przez Monikę Sobotę, specjalizującą się w fotografii kobiecej - czyli materiał, który możesz wykorzystać w swoim portfolio.

To nie będzie kolejny wykład.
To praktyka tego, jak wyróżnić się w tłumie. Lepiej wykorzystać własne atuty, świadomie pracować ciałem i twarzą oraz pewniej prezentować się przed ludźmi i obiektywem.

📍 Warszawa
Zdjęcia: 2.09
Przymiarka: 28 lub 29 sierpnia
Stawka za dzień zdjęciowy: 250 zł
Stawka za przymiarkę: 50 zł
Płatność gotówką

Zgłoszenia prosimy wysyłać na adres:
juliacast.kontakt@gmail.com

Tytuł wiadomości: KELNER
W treści zgłoszenia prosimy podać:
zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki,
aktualne zdjęcia fryzury z boku i z tyłu,
informację o doświadczeniu lub umiejętnościach kelnerskich,

wiek i wzrost,
